text: ああ…　コラッタが　どくを　あびちゃったぞ……　どくに　なると　すこしずつ　たいりょくが　へって　しまうんだ

structure.jp: コラッタが　どくを　あびちゃったぞ……
structure.en: Rattata went and got hit with poison...

structure.jp: すこしずつ　たいりょくが　へって　しまうんだ
structure.en: its HP goes down little by little

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった. あびちゃった = 'went and got hit with it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. どくに　なると = 'when it gets poisoned'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push a point strongly. あびちゃったぞ = 'it got hit, look!'
